entries.what: Noemi sleeps in until 9, then does a Monday study block at the kitchen table at Verdant Commons. Her latest practice exam run averages 80% after the subnetting drills, the first time she is over the pass line.
entries.outcome: Score is over the ~75% pass line; she decides which topics to drill next.

entries.what: Shares the 80% result and asks what to drill next. This is a one-off check-in on a good score, with the exam already moved to Dec 6 because of overtime weeks ago.
entries.outcome: Plans port numbers and harder subnetting for the week.

entries.what: Drives the 9 minutes to Ruel Road for the 1 p.m. ten-hour swing and stops at the Ruel Road station for gas first. She spends the afternoon in the cage on the scanner pile.
entries.outcome: Clears a dozen handhelds before the night shift handoff.

entries.what: Works late covering Greg's old duties, including vendor tickets and updating the RMA sheet. Gets home after 11:30 and winds down.
entries.outcome: Tells Iris about the score before bed.

entries.what: Veterans Day: Ridgeline runs as usual, so Noemi has a slow morning with Iris, who has the day off from the dental office, before her swing.
entries.outcome: Makes coffee and a late breakfast together.

entries.what: Spends the early afternoon on subnetting drills, then works the 1 p.m. swing and trains Bao on battery swaps and trigger boards from 3 to 5.
entries.outcome: Bao handles two repairs alone.

entries.what: A busy night with several handhelds failing, a red-beep night, and Carla texts her about dead scanners on the outbound floor.
entries.outcome: Swaps out eight units and gets the floor back on rate.

entries.what: Late morning at home, Noemi drafts a cover letter for outside network tech roles and asks for help with it. She wants the line to say she 'supported the team' instead of 'ran the desk during peak'.
entries.outcome: Gets a draft but keeps the soft wording until Iris weighs in.

entries.what: Drives to the 1 p.m. swing. The cage is stacked with scanners and Acting Victor is out of the office again.
entries.outcome: She handles the vendor RMA batch herself.

entries.what: Eats a leftover rice bowl at her desk and gets in a few port-number flashcards between tickets.
entries.outcome: Memorizes the common ports.

entries.what: Gets home after the shift. Iris has left the budget sheet open on the table, and Noemi checks the December trip savings.
entries.outcome: Cushion is on track.

entries.what: The first fall storm hits and rain floods Ruel Road. Noemi's usual 9-minute drive takes much longer around the potholes and standing water.
entries.outcome: Arrives a bit late but before the handoff.

entries.what: Wet totes and water-damaged scanners flood the cage. She and Bao dry out and test units through the shift.
entries.outcome: Several handhelds go onto the RMA sheet.

entries.what: Iris orders sushi as usual on Thursday and saves Noemi a box to eat when she gets in past 11:30.
entries.outcome: Eats it cold and goes to bed.

entries.what: The storm continues and Noemi wakes to rain, pushing her morning study block to a mock quiz on ports.
entries.outcome: Scores high on the ports section.

entries.what: Works the swing and picks up Taquería Colima for her Friday shift meal on the way in.
entries.outcome: Eats tacos in the IT cage.

entries.what: Another wet red-beep night with many scanners going down, and she works with Carla and a shift lead to replace them quickly.
entries.outcome: Floor recovers rate by 10 p.m.

entries.what: It is the three-year anniversary. Noemi skips the boardwalk because the planks are slick in November and sleeps in.
entries.outcome: Spends a lazy morning at home.

entries.what: Works her Saturday overtime shift this week and fixes scanners in the cage until the afternoon.
entries.outcome: Leaves in time to get ready for dinner.

entries.what: Dinner at a Calle Ortega restaurant at 7 p.m. for their anniversary, as booked.
entries.outcome: A relaxed evening and a good dinner together.

entries.what: Sunday morning at her parents' fourplex off Vinca fixing her mom's phone and the printer while Mateo asks about PC parts.
entries.outcome: Printer works again and she talks Mateo's build with him.

entries.what: An afternoon study session of subnetting drills and practice tests at home.
entries.outcome: Holds her 80% average.

entries.what: Plays the co-op survival game on her ultrawide with her online squad as packetloss_.
entries.outcome: Wins a long run.
